short.en: Cleans emails imported by the mail collector: removes signatures, logos, disclaimers, quoted replies and heavy formatting before they become tickets or follow-ups. Free alternative to Ticket Cleaner for GLPI 11.

long.en:
**Email Ticket Cleaner** cleans every email the GLPI mail collector imports, for new tickets and for follow-ups, so the ticket timeline shows only what the sender wrote. Free and open source, by OMNICOM s.r.o.
### What it removes - The signature and everything below it: logos, contact and social icons, legal disclaimers (Outlook, Gmail, Apple Mail and Thunderbird markers) - Quoted reply and forward threads - Text after a sign-off phrase on its own line, such as "Best regards" or "Sent from my iPhone" (editable list) - Text matched by your own regular-expression rules, in the message or the ticket title - Banners such as Microsoft 365's "You don't often get email from..." notice - Fonts, colours and styling; text, links, lists, tables and pasted screenshots stay - Logos and icons from the removed part are not saved as documents; real attachments are kept
### Safe by design - Only imported email is cleaned; tickets and follow-ups created in GLPI, and later edits, are never changed - If cleaning fails or would leave too little text, the original email is kept unchanged - Rules only remove text; logs never contain message content
### Requirements GLPI 11.0.11 to 11.0.x, on-premise and GLPI Network Cloud, PHP 8.2 or later. GLPI 12 support is planned.
### Security updates Free security fixes for at least five years from each release, published as security releases with an advisory: [GitHub Releases](https://github.com/OMNICOM-Digital/emailticketcleaner/releases). Security policy: [SECURITY.md](https://github.com/OMNICOM-Digital/emailticketcleaner/blob/main/SECURITY.md).
Email Ticket Cleaner is a separate plugin by OMNICOM s.r.o., not a new version of the "Ticket Cleaner" plugin (GLPI 10 only).
